messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — kicking off Hawthorn Analytics onboarding. Main goals: get API integrated into staging, complete security review, and run first production-like load test within 14 days. Quick run-through of stakeholders and risks?

lia_csm: Thanks — quick roster: Hawthorn PM = Claire (business owner), Eng lead = Arjun, Security = Priya, Data lead = Mateo. They've asked for a dedicated onboarding cadence.

devon_pm: Re: timelines — Hawthorn wants go/no-go for pilot in two weeks. We should sketch a 14-day plan with daily standups first 5 days, then 2x/week.

maria_cs: Agree. Proposed success criteria: 1) API calls from their staging app succeed at 200ms p50 and <500ms p95 for baseline workload, 2) no data exfil concerns after security checklist, 3) docs/training delivered and their staff can run basic prompt tests independently.

ben_eng: Heads-up on p95 target — depends on model choice and batching. We can commit to p50 ~200ms on our smallest vCPU-backed model, but if they need larger context we'll need dedicated capacity. I'll provide perf matrix by EOD.

lia_csm: Noted. Also renewal risk flags: single-point contact (Claire), custom integration payloads, and data residency ask for EU-only processing. We should surface these to sales/account exec.

maria_cs: @tom_se can you take EU data residency off the top? Is Private deployment an option for pilot?

tom_se: EU-only can be done via our Private region or by routing to eu-hosted hosted models. For pilot we'd need a processing agreement and possibly a short SOW. I'll draft options.

onboard-bot: ACTION CREATED: #1234 — "Hawthorn data residency options" assigned to tom_se, due 2024-11-04.

devon_pm: Logistics / enablement plan: training session #1 (API walkthrough + auth) Day 2, training #2 (ops + cost controls) Day 7, hands-on runbook session Day 12. We should also share a lightweight runbook and an integration checklist.

maria_cs: Good. For feedback capture: propose a shared Google form + #hawthorn-feedback Slack channel for async notes. Also short daily NPS-style pulse at EOD first 5 days.

lia_csm: I'll own the pulse and weekly feedback digest. I'll create the form and post link after standup.

ben_eng: Quick integration snippet for staging to share with Hawthorn engineers:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-mini\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```

maria_cs: Perfect. Action items I have so far:
- ben_eng: perf matrix by EOD (action: perf-matrix)
- tom_se: options + SOW draft (action: data-residency)
- lia_csm: create feedback form + channel (action: feedback-setup)
- devon_pm: schedule trainings + runbook (action: schedule-enablement)

lia_csm: Adding one more risk: if their billing cadence mismatches our reserved capacity lead times, that could delay Dedicated options which affects latency guarantees. Recommend sales be looped in today.

maria_cs: Agreed. @devon_pm please add sales@ to the next update.

devon_pm: Will do. Setting next sync Monday 09:30 PT. First standup tomorrow 10:00 PT.

maria_cs: Thanks all — I'll post a short agenda in the calendar invite and the shared drive doc. :thumbsup:
